summary: [Web] SKM import lets a Project Manager add equipment to a site they are not assigned to (only by sending the request directly, not from the screen)
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
SKM is the engineering program customers use for power studies. *SKM > Import* on the Assets page loads equipment from an SKM file into the current site.
A Project Manager who is not assigned to a site cannot pick that site in the app, and the server refuses to show them its diagram.
But the two server requests behind the SKM import (check the file, then import it) still accept that site and create new equipment on it.
A normal user cannot do this from the screen, because the site is not offered in the site picker; it takes sending the two requests from the browser console.
It matters because someone with no access to a site can still add equipment to it, and the people who work on that site then find equipment that nobody on the site added.
The import should be refused for a site the user is not assigned to, exactly like the diagram read already is.

!ZP-4849-key-highlighted.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
The diagram read is refused (422 permission denied), but the import check answers "will create 1" and the import itself answers 200 with "created_nodes: 1". A new bus, "QA-DEMO PM scope test (delete me)", is now on a site this user was never given. On the Assets page it is listed as a Panelboard.

h3. Expected result
Both requests (check and import) are refused with "permission denied" for a site that is not in the user's assigned sites, exactly like the diagram read. Nothing is created.

h3. Test data
* Environment: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai (QA)
* Role / test login: Project Manager abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com (customer user, not Egalvanic staff, 116 assigned sites; has the data.import permission)
* Site (not assigned to this user, not offered in the picker): "QA-DEMO ZP-4582 SKM namespace (delete me)", id cfc07c0d-71a2-40bc-bd14-76ad2372ffbd
* To see the result (step 5): Super Admin (Egalvanic staff) abhiyant.singh+admin@egalvanic.com, *Site Data > Assets* of that site: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets
* Running the code creates one bus labelled "QA-DEMO PM scope test (delete me)" on that QA-DEMO site. QA deleted its own test bus after the re-check.
* QA build: re-checked 14 Oct 2026 on index-G6uKkjPx.js (full run, Screenshots 1 to 3) and on index-D-HsTlcR.js (read 422, import check "will create 1"). First found 13 Oct 2026 (index-C14cwR0U.js).

h3. Steps to reproduce
1. Sign in to https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai as the Project Manager abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com.
2. Open the *Current site* box and type {{QA-DEMO ZP-4582}}. The app says "No sites available": this site is not assigned to this user. (Screenshot 1)
!ZP-4849-1-pm-site-not-offered.png|width=720!
3. Open the browser console (F12 > Console) on any app page and paste:
{noformat}
const SITE = 'cfc07c0d-71a2-40bc-bd14-76ad2372ffbd'; // "QA-DEMO ZP-4582 SKM namespace (delete me)"
const xml = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><s:SKM xmlns:s="http://www.skm.com/schemas/powersystem" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"><s:PowerSystem><s:Components><s:Bus s:action="create" s:id="961" s:name="QA-DEMO PM scope test (delete me)" s:altId="" s:altName="" xsi:ID="skm961"><s:Field s:id="37552142" s:name="NodeBus" s:value="False"/></s:Bus></s:Components><s:Topology></s:Topology></s:PowerSystem></s:SKM>`;
console.log('read', (await fetch(`/api/sld/${SITE}/graph`)).status);           // 422 - read refused (correct)
const fd = new FormData(); fd.append('xml_file', new File([xml], 'probe.xml', {type: 'text/xml'})); fd.append('sld_id', SITE);
const pv = await (await fetch('/api/skm/import-xml/preview', {method: 'POST', body: fd})).json();
console.log('preview', pv.summary.will_create_nodes);                           // 1 - should be refused
const cm = await fetch('/api/skm/import-xml/commit', {method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({token: pv.token, sld_id: SITE, skm_namespace: 'QA-DEMO-PM-SCOPE-TEST'})});
console.log('commit', cm.status, await cm.json());                             // 200, created 1 - should be refused
{noformat}
4. Result: the read is refused (422), the import check says "will create 1", and the import answers 200 with "created_nodes: 1". (Screenshot 2)
!ZP-4849-2-pm-import-accepted-on-unassigned-site.png|width=720!
5. Sign in as the Super Admin abhiyant.singh+admin@egalvanic.com, pick site "QA-DEMO ZP-4582 SKM namespace (delete me)", open *Site Data > Assets* and search {{PM scope}}. The new bus "QA-DEMO PM scope test (delete me)" is on the site (listed as a Panelboard). (Screenshot 3)
!ZP-4849-3-admin-sees-new-bus-on-site.png|width=720!
6. Clean-up: delete the test bus "QA-DEMO PM scope test (delete me)" from that site.

h3. Notes for the developer
* {{/api/skm/import-xml/preview}} and {{/api/skm/import-xml/commit}} check the company but not caller_can_reach_sld(sld_id). Please cover them in the same pass as ZP-4865 and the ZP-4709 follow-up.
* The Project Manager has data.import; the missing check is the site assignment, not the permission.
* Not tested: whether re-import matching can also UPDATE existing equipment on such a site. This ticket only claims "create". Same kind of gap as ZP-4865 (SLD edits), different endpoints.
* Earlier evidence from 13 Oct stays attached (A1-4849, A2-4849, 2-skm-import, 2b-node-written).

summary: [Web] SKM export switch OFF hides Export on Assets but not 'Export Engineering XML' on the SLD page (please confirm intended)
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
There is a switch that turns the SKM export feature on or off for a company.
With the switch OFF, the *Export* item correctly disappears from *Site Data > Assets > SKM*.
But the same SKM file can also be exported from the SLD page (*Export > Export Engineering XML*). That menu does not look at the switch, so the item stays and the file still downloads.
So turning the switch off does not fully turn SKM export off.
Important: the switch is really ON for Acme on QA, so QA could only simulate the OFF state in its own test browser; a real flip is requested to confirm.
The SLD-page export existed before this switch was added, so this may be intended. Please confirm with product: either hide it too while the switch is OFF, or close this as by design.

!ZP-4850-key-highlighted.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
With the switch simulated OFF, the *Assets > SKM* menu has no *Export* (correct). The SLD page *Export* menu still lists *Export Engineering XML*. Clicking it opens the "Before you export to SKM" window, and after its two "I understand" boxes are ticked, *Export Engineering XML* still downloads the SKM file (a zip with the SKM XML and "READ THIS BEFORE IMPORTING.pdf").

h3. Expected result (please confirm with product)
If the switch is meant to turn SKM export off everywhere, the SLD-page *Export Engineering XML* item is hidden too while the switch is OFF. If the SLD-page item is meant to stay (it existed before the switch), close this as by design.

summary: [Web] SKM Export: the 'label numbers from location' help text still promises a '-1, -2' suffix that the export no longer adds
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
In the SKM export window there is an option "Generate arc-flash label numbers from location" with a small round "i" help icon.
Hovering the icon shows help text saying each bus gets its Building/Floor/Room plus "-1, -2, ..." as its label number.
Since ZP-4760 the export no longer adds that "-1, -2": it writes the location label exactly as it is, so all buses in the same room get the same label.
So the help text describes something that does not happen, and a user may expect unique labels that the file will not have.
The text should be updated to match what the export really does (no "-1, -2"), in English and in French.

!ZP-4853-key-highlighted.png|width=720!
*EXPECTED (mock-up):* !ZP-4853-expected-mockup.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
The help text says: "Each bus gets Building/Floor/Room plus -1, -2, … as its SKM arc-flash label number. Buses that already have a label number keep it; buses with no location are left blank." But the exported file gives the three buses of a room the same label, with nothing added (for example QDA-BUS-MAIN, QDA-BUS-LOAD and QDB-BUS-MAIN all get "QA Bldg-North/Fl 1-2/Rm A-B").

h3. Expected result
The help text matches the export, for example: "Each bus gets its Building/Floor/Room as its SKM arc-flash label number; buses with no location are left blank." The same change in the French text.

h3. Test data
* Environment: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai (QA)
* Role / test login: Project Manager abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com (for the help text); Super Admin abhiyant.singh+admin@egalvanic.com (for the export proof, because the Project Manager is not assigned to the QA-DEMO site)
* Site for the help text: "(s) Wild Goose Brewery"; Assets page: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets
* Site for the export proof: "QA-DEMO ZP-4582 SKM namespace (delete me)", id cfc07c0d-71a2-40bc-bd14-76ad2372ffbd. Room "QA Bldg/North > Fl 1/2 > Rm A/B" holds the buses QDA-BUS-MAIN, QDA-BUS-LOAD and QDB-BUS-MAIN; room "QA Bldg South > F2 > R2" holds QDC-BUS-MAIN, QDD-NODEBUS and QDD-DCBUS.
* Exported file used: {{skm_export_cfc07c0d_2026-10-14_100017.zip}}
* QA build: re-checked 14 Oct 2026 on index-D-HsTlcR.js (help text unchanged in English and French; export as described). First found 13 Oct 2026 (index-C14cwR0U.js).

h3. Steps to reproduce

2. Open *Site Data > Assets* (https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets), click *SKM* then *Export*. The "Export to SKM XML" window opens with the option "Generate arc-flash label numbers from location" and a small round "i" icon. (Screenshot 1)

summary: [Web] Bulk Import of an unchanged Bulk Export shows 20 asset and 4 connection changes and would overwrite values (e.g. a generator's voltage 240 → 200)
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
A user exports the assets of a site with *Bulk Export*, does not touch the file, and loads the same file back with *Bulk Import*.
The *Review* step should say that nothing changed. Instead it lists 20 assets and 4 connections "to update".
None of these changes come from the user; the import misreads its own file in three ways:
* Text values such as Catalog Number "56", Size "67" and Serial Number "89" (and the connection length "89") would be saved as "56.0", "67.0" and "89.0".
* On 19 assets, the empty Voltage and Ampere Rating fields would be filled with 240 and 800, copied from other columns of the same file.
* On Generator-1, the voltage 240 would be replaced by 200 taken from a second "voltage" column.

If the user clicks *Process Import*, all of this is written to the real assets. It matters because a round trip with no edits should change nothing; here it silently proposes changes, including a wrong voltage.
An unchanged export should re-import as "No changes".

!ZP-4854-key-highlighted-v2.png|width=720!
*EXPECTED (mock-up):* !ZP-4854-expected-mockup.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
For a file that was not edited, the Review step shows "Assets: 20 to update" and "Connections: 4 to update":
* 19 assets (for example "abhiy ant", "final test 2", "QOB"): voltage (empty) → 240.0, ampere_rating (empty) → 800, Catalog Number 56 → 56.0, Size 67 → 67.0, Serial Number 89 → 89.0.
* Generator-1: voltage 240.0 → 200.0.
* 4 connections: Length (ft) 89 → 89.0.

h3. Expected result
An unchanged export re-imports as "No changes" (0 assets and 0 connections to update).

h3. Test data
* Environment: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai (QA)
* Role / test login: Project Manager abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com
* Site: "(s) Wild Goose Brewery" (id 9138fd14-a3c9-495a-b086-6ef520f92168); Assets page: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets
* File used: {{(s)_Wild_Goose_Brewery_bulk_edit.xlsx}}, its own fresh Bulk Export, not opened or edited
* Generator-1: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets/bb0b3d39-91ea-40c3-b2e3-869eca62b262 (voltage 240V; a second "voltage" field holds 200)
* QA build: re-checked 14 Oct 2026 on index-G6uKkjPx.js (screens) and index-D-HsTlcR.js (same 20 and 4 from the server's check). First found 13 Oct 2026. QA did NOT click *Process Import*.

h3. Steps to reproduce
1. Sign in to https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai as the Project Manager abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com, pick site "(s) Wild Goose Brewery" and open *Site Data > Assets* (https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets).
2. Click *Bulk Edit > Bulk Export*. The file {{(s)_Wild_Goose_Brewery_bulk_edit.xlsx}} downloads.
3. Do not open the file. Click *Bulk Edit > Bulk Import* and upload that same file.
4. On *Resolve Conflicts*, choose "Skip this reference" for the one ambiguous name ("Panelboard-1" matches 2 assets) and click *Continue*. (Screenshot 1)
!ZP-4854-1-resolve-conflicts-skip-ambiguous-name.png|width=720!
5. The Review says *Assets: 20 to update* and *Connections: 4 to update*, and lists the unchanged values as changes. (Screenshot 2: first run, 13 Oct; Screenshot 3: re-check)
!7-unchanged-bulk-export-reimport-shows-changes.png|width=720!
!C1-4854-unchanged-export-reimport-review.png|width=720!
6. Scroll the list. Generator-1: voltage 240.0 → 200.0 (Screenshot 4). At the end, the connections: Length (ft) 89 → 89.0 (Screenshot 5).
!C2-4854-generator-1-change.png|width=720!
!ZP-4854-4-connections-length-89-to-89-0.png|width=720!
7. Do NOT click *Process Import* (QA did not). Click *Cancel*.

h3. Notes for the developer
* Proof from the untouched file (Assets sheet): for the 19 assets, {{node.voltage}} and {{node.ampere_rating}} are empty while the columns "Voltage" and "Ampere Rating" hold "240V" and "800A"; the import copies them into the main fields. Catalog Number, Size and Serial Number are text cells ("56", "67", "89") and come back as "56.0", "67.0", "89.0", so text fields such as Serial Number would really change on Process Import. Connections sheet: "Length (ft)" is the text "89".
* Generator-1 row: {{node.voltage}} is "240V" and a separate column "voltage" is "200"; the import lets that column overwrite the main voltage. The problem is the round trip, not the data: the user did not change anything.
* The asset "testv " (row 57) also shows asset_name "testv" → "testv" (a trailing space is trimmed).
* Suggested fix: compare each cell with the exported value as text before treating it as a change, and do not let attribute columns overwrite node fields on import. Related to ZP-4592 (same feature), not a duplicate.

summary: [Web] SLD: an engineer who is not assigned to a site can still change that site's diagram (connections, asset data, asset positions) by sending the save requests directly, and the change is saved for everyone
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
Every user only works on the sites (buildings) they are assigned to.
An Electrical Engineer who is NOT assigned to a site cannot pick that site in the app, and the server refuses to show them its one-line diagram (SLD).
But the server still accepts that engineer's save requests for that site's diagram. QA used them to show a hidden connection again, to store a test value on an asset, and to move another asset.
All three changes were saved, and the Project Manager who is assigned to the site then saw the changed diagram.
A normal user cannot do this by clicking in the app: it takes the same save requests the SLD editor sends, sent from the browser console.
It matters because an engineer of the company could change or break the diagram of a building they were never given, and the people who really work on that site would then work with wrong data.
The server should refuse these saves for sites the user is not assigned to, the same way it already refuses to show them the diagram.

!ZP-4865-key-highlighted.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
* For the Electrical Engineer (not assigned to the site) the server refuses to show the diagram (422 permission denied) but accepts all three saves (200).
* The changes are stored: after a reload the Project Manager sees the hidden connection as a full line again and the asset "QA G-Meter" in a new place, and the asset "QA-DEMO 4799 JBOX" carries the engineer's test value (it is not shown on screen; step 5 shows how to read it).

h3. Expected result
The server refuses every change to a site the user is not assigned to (422 / 403 permission denied), exactly as it refuses to read that site's diagram. Nothing is saved.

summary: [Web] Client Portal users can open the full Arc Flash Readiness page (with report export) by typing its address, although their menu hides it
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
A Client Portal user is a customer contact who should only see the customer-facing pages.
Their menu correctly has no Engineering section and no "Arc Flash Readiness" link.
But if they type the page address (/arc-flash) into the browser, the full Arc Flash Readiness page opens.
They then see the site's readiness numbers per equipment class, the building filter, Engineering Mode and an "Export readiness report" button.
Other engineering pages, for example the SLD page, correctly show "Access Denied" when their address is typed.
They already see one headline number ("Arc Flash Readiness 13%") as a card on the Assets page; the problem is the full page and its report export.
It matters because the Client Portal role is not given permission for this page, so customers get engineering detail and an export they are not meant to have.
Typing /arc-flash should show "Access Denied" (or send them back), like the other engineering pages.

!ZP-4866-key-highlighted.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
As the Client Portal user, typing https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/arc-flash opens the full Arc Flash Readiness page with real site data: the 13% / 33% / 0% gauges, the per-class cards, the building filter, Engineering Mode and "Export readiness report". The report window also opens.

h3. Expected result
Typing /arc-flash is refused for the Client Portal user ("Access Denied" or a redirect), the same as typing /slds and /equipment-designations. The page is only for roles that have the arc-flash view permission.

h3. Test data
* Environment: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai (QA)
* Client Portal user: abhiyant.singh+clientportal@egalvanic.com (role Client Portal, customer user, not Egalvanic staff; does not have the arc-flash view permission)
* Site: "Android Site 2" (picked in *Current site*)
* Address typed: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/arc-flash
* Controls typed by the same user: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/slds and https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/equipment-designations (both "Access Denied")
* Headline card: Site Data › Assets, https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets
* Super Admin control: abhiyant.singh+admin@egalvanic.com (menu has "Arc Flash Readiness")
* QA build: re-checked 14 Oct 2026 on index-G6uKkjPx.js and index-D-HsTlcR.js: still reproduces. First found 13 Oct 2026 (index-C14cwR0U.js).

h3. Steps to reproduce
1. Sign in to https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai as the Client Portal user abhiyant.singh+clientportal@egalvanic.com and pick site "Android Site 2". The left menu has only "Site Data" and "Maintenance Portal": no Engineering section and no "Arc Flash Readiness" link. (Screenshot 1)
!2-1-cp-menu-has-no-engineering.png|width=720!
2. Control, same user: type https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/slds (another engineering page) in the address bar. It is correctly refused with "Access Denied". (Screenshot 2)
!2-2-control-cp-typed-slds-access-denied.png|width=720!
3. Now type https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/arc-flash in the address bar. The full Arc Flash Readiness page opens: the gauges, the per-class cards with real numbers, the building filter, Engineering Mode and the "Export readiness report" button. (Screenshot 3)
!2-3-cp-typed-arc-flash-page-opens.png|width=720!
4. Click "Export readiness report": the report window opens for the Client Portal user too (not submitted in this test). (Screenshot 4)
!2-4-cp-export-readiness-report-window.png|width=720!
5. Control: a Super Admin has an Engineering menu with "Arc Flash Readiness"; the page is meant for roles that have it. (Screenshot 5)
!2-5-control-super-admin-menu-has-arc-flash.png|width=720!
6. For context: on *Site Data › Assets* the Client Portal user already sees the headline card "Arc Flash Readiness 13%, 261 of 2048 fields • 4 unclassified". Clicking that card does nothing: the page stays on Assets. (Screenshot 6) So the headline number is meant to be visible; the bug is the full page and its export.
!ZP-4866-5-cp-assets-headline-card-click-does-nothing.png|width=720!

h3. Notes for the developer
* The route guard table has /arc-flash with {{features.arc_flash.view}}, but /arc-flash is also in the layout's direct-render list (pathname check), so the permission check is skipped. /slds and /equipment-designations are guarded correctly. Unchanged in index-D-HsTlcR.js.
* While the page is open as the Client Portal user, {{/api/lookup/nodes/<site>}}, {{/api/sld/<site>/edges}} and {{/api/sld/<site>/library-designations}} all answer 200 (re-checked 14 Oct).
* Related: ZP-4699 (removed Engineering surfaces from the Client Portal); it did not cover the /arc-flash route.
* The earlier Screenshots 6 and 7 (D4-4866, D5-4866) stay attached; they were the same frame without a highlight, so one highlighted frame replaces them.
